items.title: 71542_Bill Coleman autobiographical manuscript
items.q: I've seen films and more films that I shall never forget and the same thing goes for many actors that make them. But there is a special reason that I shall never forget 'Lost Weekend' and the featured actor whose name was Ray Milland.

ctx.x: We were served meals by beautiful Japanese girls in native dresses and the food was like it would have been in a fine hotel, and not an army camp, although the food in the camps was not all bad, except for the cocks that lost the fights, on Sundays and holidays, in the camp near Manila.

One large room in Honcho House had been transformed into a movie hall and the first night we were there, a film called "Lost Weekend" was shown. I've seen films and more films that I shall never forget and the same thing goes for many actors that make them. But there is a special reason that I shall never forget "Lost Weekend" and the featured actor whose name was Ray Milland.

When we left the Philippines, I didn't think it would be necessary to take at least a small supply of Kick-a-poo-joy juice with me. It was possible to get beer on the boat, but I was never a great beer drinker, although I did drink it now and then as a chaser.
